asset_types.description: Console background image displayed before connecting to a server.
asset_types.notes:
Stock pak0 ships gfx/conback.lmp. Custom overrides install to
qw/gfx/conback.<ext> and shadow the stock via engine search-path
precedence (qw/ wins over id1/), not via file replacement.

asset_types.description: Console text font (charset texture, 16x16 grid of 8x8 glyphs).
asset_types.notes: ezQuake loads via `gl_consolefont <name>` cvar; FTE has a separate mechanism.

asset_types.description: HUD crosshair image overlay drawn over the viewport.
asset_types.notes:
Engine loads via `crosshairimage <name>` cvar (no extension; engine probes .png/.tga/.pcx).
No stock origin -- built-in crosshair glyphs live inside the charset, not a separate file.

asset_types.description: 256-color palette for indexed-color rendering (768 bytes, 256 RGB triplets).

format_magic_bytes.notes: Exactly 768 bytes of raw RGB data.

asset_types.notes: Stock-only; rarely overridden. Listed for completeness.

asset_types.description: 256x64 light/color shift lookup table for software-renderer-era rendering.
asset_types.notes: Stock-only.

asset_types.description: HUD overlay element (numbers, faces, weapon icons) replacing gfx.wad lumps.
asset_types.notes:
Filename matches the WAD lump name being replaced (num_0, num_1, face1, ...).
Stock HUD elements ship inside id1/gfx.wad; the texture-replacement system
finds external override files at textures/wad/<name>.<ext>.

asset_types.description: WAD2/WAD3 archive containing HUD lumps or map textures.
asset_types.notes:
Engine reads WAD files at gamedir root (qw/<name>.wad). Map authors reference them
via worldspawn.wad. id1/gfx.wad is the stock HUD wad that hud_element overrides target.

asset_types.description: Six-image cubemap (right/left/front/back/up/down). Engines probe several path patterns; ezQuake limits to env/ and gfx/env/, FTE additionally accepts bare-root <skyname><suffix>.
asset_types.notes:
Suffix conventions: {rt,bk,lf,ft,up,dn} with optional underscore separator.
Skybox name comes from worldspawn.sky in the BSP, the r_skybox cvar (FTE),
or the r_skyname cvar (ezQuake). Both engines probe each face across multiple
directory prefixes -- gfx_faq's "qw/env/" guidance is the recommended single
install location but is not the only path the engine accepts.

asset_types.description: Map intermission preview image shown at end-of-level / map selection.
asset_types.notes: ezQuake-specific; filename matches the map's canonical name.

asset_types.description: Player-model skin replacement loaded via teamskin/enemyskin cvars.
asset_types.notes:
Stock player skin (player.mdl skin 0) lives inside id1/progs/player.mdl, not as
a separate file. Replacement is loaded via /teamskin and /enemyskin cvars naming
a file in qw/skins/.

asset_types.description: Quake-format alias model (.mdl) for players, weapons, monsters, items.
asset_types.notes:
Stock player/weapon/monster/item models ship in id1/pak0. Embedded skins live
inside the .mdl file; external skin replacement uses the player_skin or
model_texture mechanism instead.

asset_types.description: Hi-res texture replacement for a .mdl model's skin (worldmodel or viewmodel).
asset_types.notes:
Replaces the skin baked into a .mdl. Filename matches the model name
(v_axe -> v_axe.tga, or v_axe_0.tga for skin index 0).
Distinct from hud_element (HUD overlays) and map_texture (BSP-embedded textures).

asset_types.description: BSP map geometry file (.bsp).
asset_types.notes:
Stock id1 ships e1m1-e4m8, dm1-dm6, start, end, plus b_*.bsp ammo box "maps"
(technically BSPs; filtered as non-playable). ezQuake L1 also surfaces .ent
override sites (SV_SpawnServer), .qpn physics-normals (CM_LoadPhysicsNormals),
and .pts leak-pointfile (R_ReadPointFile_f) under the same `map` category.

asset_types.description: Hi-res texture override for a BSP-embedded texture (map-scoped or global).
asset_types.notes:
Filename must match a texture name embedded in the target BSP's texture lump
(cross-reference qw-bsp-textures.json). Map-scoped path wins over global.
`#`-prefixed names (#teleport, #lava, ...) install at qw/textures/#<name>.tga or
per-map qw/textures/<mapname>/#<name>.tga (gfx_faq QID 22).

asset_types.description: Colored lighting overlay file (.lit) sidecar to a BSP.
asset_types.notes: Per-face RGB lighting overrides for BSPs; filename matches the BSP basename.

asset_types.description: Override entity file (.ent) replacing a BSP's embedded entity lump.
asset_types.notes:
Server-side override for entity placements (item spawns, spawnpoints, etc.)
without re-vis-ing the BSP. Both engines tag these sites with the broader
`map` category at L1; the asset-type catalog disambiguates via the
SV_SpawnServer enclosing function and the .ent path templates.

asset_types.description: Location marker file (.loc) for teamplay coordinate-to-location lookup.

format_magic_bytes.notes: Plain text: 'X Y Z "location name"' per line.

asset_types.notes: ezQuake teamplay uses these for `%l` macro expansion in chat.

asset_types.description: Sound effect (.wav for stock; .ogg supported by modern engines).
asset_types.notes:
Stock sounds ship in id1/pak0 (weapons/items/ambient). Custom sounds override by
same-path matching (qw/sound/weapons/sshotgun.wav shadows stock SSG fire).

asset_types.description: User-editable config / RC file loaded via /exec.

format_magic_bytes.notes: Plain text: cvar/command lines, hash comments.

asset_types.notes:
Stock id1 ships default.cfg + qw/quake.rc. Custom configs install to gamedir root
and are typically loaded via /exec <name>.cfg from another script (or from quake.rc).

asset_types.description: Recorded gameplay demo (.mvd preferred for QW; .qwd legacy; .dem single-player).

format_magic_bytes.notes: ASCII map-name header, then binary message stream.

asset_types.notes: Out of scope for the gfx.quakeworld.nu corpus; listed for completeness.

asset_types.description: Compressed demo archive (.qwz Quake-Wizard; .dz dzip).

format_magic_bytes.notes: Container; engines call out to qwz<->mvd transcoder.

asset_types.notes: Auto-extracted before playback.
